description: This file contains utility functions related to rendering and managing progress and flow bars in a web application, specifically within the SuiteCRM or SugarCRM context. It includes functions for displaying progress bars, flow animations, and flushing output buffers.

methods.name: progress_bar_flush
methods.description: Flushes the output buffer, either via ob_flush() if output buffering is active or directly with flush().

methods.name: display_flow_bar
methods.description: Displays an animated flow bar with a specific name, size, and delay, initiating its animation sequence.

methods.name: start_flow_bar
methods.description: Begins the flow bar animation by setting up JavaScript timers to update the bar appearance.

methods.name: destroy_flow_bar
methods.description: Stops the flow bar animation and clears its HTML content.

methods.name: display_progress_bar
methods.description: Displays a visual progress bar indicating current completion status out of total.

methods.name: update_progress_bar
methods.description: Updates the progress bar's visual state based on current progress.
